caveats: The Q4 value is derived (annual FY2024 figure minus the nine-month year-to-date figure through 2024-06-29), not a directly reported quarterly figure.

claims.text: Apple's research and development expense for fiscal Q4 2024 (2024-06-30 to 2024-09-28) was about $7.765 billion ($7,765,000,000), derived as full-year FY2024 R&D of $31.37 billion minus the nine-month figure of $23.605 billion.

raw_output.summary: Apple's research and development expense in fiscal Q4 2024 (June 30 to September 28, 2024) was about $7.765 billion. This figure is derived from the annual total less the nine-month year-to-date figure.
